fighterDuel.title: Fighting Game
fighterDuel.help: Read the opponent's stance and play what beats it — 1 Attack · 2 Guard · 3 Special
fighterDuel.help_touch: Read the opponent's stance and play what beats it with the buttons below
fighterDuel.hint: Find the opponent's move shown above on one of the “beats ○○” buttons

rules.controls: Number keys 1 Attack · 2 Guard · 3 Special — the buttons below work too
rules.controls_touch: Use the three buttons below (Attack · Guard · Special)
rules.triangle: Attack → Special → Guard → Attack. A special breaks through a guard, and a special needs a windup an attack can cut short
rules.clock: The opponent telegraphs the next move with a stance — press the button that beats the name shown before the timer runs out
rules.feint: They may change stance mid-tell (a feint). Answer fast for a read, chain wins for a combo — both hit harder
